rationale: The stock gapped down ~5.4% at the open and is only 2 minutes into the session with extremely low relative volume (0.98x scaled to this early time, but absolute volume is thin at 558K shares with a 28.3 bps spread), making reliable directional conviction difficult. Price is sitting in the lower third of today's range (35.2%), below the 9-EMA ($124.46) and session VWAP ($123.93), with the last two candles showing continued selling pressure — but the gap-down context means both a mean-reversion bounce and continued breakdown are plausible without a clear structural edge to favor either. The risk/reward is insufficiently defined this early in the session to justify committing capital.
